places.name: July's canyon-mouth camp on the Canadian
places.note: July is haunted day and night by the three companions he left buried there.
places.location_hint: canyon mouth on the Canadian River, Texas Panhandle, west of Adobe Walls

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: July wishes Roscoe and Joe were back where they belonged, but can no longer picture living there himself.

places.name: Cimarron River
places.note: July rides north past it; three days beyond, his horse goes lame and the river is too far back to reach on foot.

places.name: July's dead horse
places.note: A cactus thorn lames July's horse; he shoots it, leaves his saddle, and walks east.
places.location_hint: open prairie about three days' ride north of the Cimarron River, four days north of the Canadian; probably southwestern Kansas

places.raw_name: a little grove of low trees
places.name: July's spring grove
places.note: After a despairing night contemplating suicide, July finds a small spring-fed pool under trees, drinks, bathes and eats a badger.
places.location_hint: on the prairie about two days' walk east of where his horse died, north of the Cimarron; probably southwestern Kansas

places.name: Creek on a wagon track
places.note: July follows a south-running wagon track to a flowing creek but finds no wagon.
places.location_hint: two days' walk east of the spring grove, north of the Cimarron, roughly five days' travel southwest of Dodge City

places.name: Johns's trail herd
places.note: Trail boss Johns sells walking July a poor bay horse for forty dollars and gives him directions.
places.location_hint: on the plains a day east of the creek, about four days' bareback ride from Dodge City, likely southwest Kansas

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: July recalls cold boyhood nights under quilts in the family cabin there.

places.name: California
places.note: The puzzled trail boss asks whether July walked in from there.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Few men come walking out of it, which makes the trail boss suspicious.

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Sore from riding bareback, July trots into town four days after buying the horse.

groups.label: July Johnson
groups.hint: just arrived on a bareback bay bought from the Johns herd

groups.label: Johns outfit
groups.hint: small herd six weeks on the trail, about four days' ride southwest of Dodge City
